examples: Get told the moment an agent asks for permission, even while you are in another session.
Several sessions are waiting while you are away: the detailed style says how many, and each card tells you what it wants ("wants permission: Bash git push") without opening it.
Finished-turn cards are noisy while you work: untick the screen column for that notification and the bell and history still record it.
A finished-turn card keeps popping on your phone while you work at the computer: tap its mute button, pick mute here, and that phone stops showing and pushing it while the computer still does.
how_to: Click a toast to open that session; dismiss it with its x. Click a question or permission toast (also from the history list, a browser push or the desktop notification) to open the approvals popup on that item instead; it closes itself once answered.
A busy session's toasts are grouped into one.

Pick the toast style under settings, notifications, toast style: compact (the default) shows each session's most urgent event; detailed shows its latest event with a descriptive title and a snippet, counts the sessions waiting, and a click opens the session and dismisses only that card.
Attach an image to a session and click the small thumbnail on the attached notice to see it full size; Esc, a click outside the picture or the close button closes it.

Settings, notifications, routing, the screen column: untick a notification to stop its pop-up card. Needs-you cards are always shown. Hiding a card hides the pop-up only; the bell, the history, the status light and the tray still keep it.

Every notification card has a mute button at its bottom right: mute here silences that type on this device (on a phone, its push too), mute everywhere silences it on every device and destination. A muted card confirms with an undo. Settings, notifications, routing, muted notifications lists each mute with where it holds and an unmute button. Muting never changes the status lights.
